question: Should maintainers accept this large behavior-neutral Control UI refactor after reviewing the current merge result and a focused live composer interaction proof?
rationale: The protected `maintainer` label requires explicit human handling, and the review environment could not complete the required current-main source and history inspection.

options.title: Review and land after proof
options.body: Confirm the current merge result preserves composer interactions and accept the focused modular split if the live Control UI check is clean.

options.title: Request narrower evidence
options.body: Keep the refactor open and ask for a redacted live Control UI transcript, recording, or runtime output that exercises the moved interaction paths.

recommendation.title: Review and land after proof
recommendation.body: Confirm the current merge result preserves composer interactions and accept the focused modular split if the live Control UI check is clean.
